title: Piercing Annihilation
paragraphs: At that moment, the older sister placed her hand on the ground and narrowed her eyes, staring intently at the location of the heart.
What is it? Then, she activated her lightning magic with a crackling sound.
“W-What’s this? I just saw… a strange flow.”
“Gaelion-chan seems to have noticed it too.”
“Is something there?”
The older sister pointed slightly below the location of the heart.
“Something is flowing into the heart from somewhere.”
“Another heart to facilitate regeneration? Maybe the real heart is somewhere else!”

Father spoke as if he had a sudden realization. Or rather, the older sister noticed it really well. It must be because she uses lightning magic, making her sensitive to electrical signals. To be able to detect even the flow of magical energy… that’s impressive.
“If this one’s a decoy… then how do we get to the real one?”
Father spread out the map he had been mapping. It’s a very complicated place. Looking at it again, it’s a bothersome area to memorize.
“The most likely place is… hmm…”
“It’s that way! The flow of magic suggests it’s definitely over there!”
“Yeah, no doubt about it.”
The older sister and Rival pointed below the heart we were fighting. This is it. I just need to do what Father did in the first world.
“Father.”
“What is it, Motoyasu-kun?”
“In situations like this, it’s faster to make a path rather than search for one. While we’re at it, how about blasting through the real heart too?”
Father must have caught on to my intention because he smirked.
“I see. If we’ve pinpointed the direction, that’s a good plan. Motoyasu-kun, can I count on you?”
“Of course!”

I had been considering it from the beginning, so this works out perfectly. I pierced the heart with Meteor Spear and then poured power into my spear. Father had already cast his support magic on me. Outside, I’m sure Itsuki is using debuffs. Rather than search aimlessly for the path to the real heart… I’ll carve a path to it along with this fake heart. Though I only noticed it after it was pointed out, I feel like I can see something faintly glowing. The tip of my spear shone brilliantly, transforming into a flash of light that pierced through everything.
“Brionac X!”
I focused my mind, and even if I missed, I would create a hole that led to the heart.
Pouring in enough power that it would take time to regenerate, I would pierce through everything right now!
“Take this! Here I go!”
Brionac, at maximum power, was fired toward the fake heart of the Spirit Tortoise. Burning and scorching the flesh, my Brionac flew straight toward the real heart.
“Whoa… that’s amazing…”

Father muttered as he looked at the hole. Before long, a bright light burst out from the hole… and it seemed that the Spirit Tortoise collapsed with a heavy thud. The regeneration of the heart had also stopped. The blue hourglass floating in my vision switched from seven to eight. A faint light gently drifted out from the hole and disappeared. Among them, one particularly large light stood out as it escaped.
What was that? I only caught a glimpse, but… was it a book?
“Did we… win?”
“Looks like we hit the mark just fine, huh?”
“Maybe? Should we dive in and check it out?”
“With such a big hole, Gaelion can fly in and check!”
“Sakura too!”
“Kou’s going too!”
“Okay, okay. Let’s all go and check it out.”

And so, we dove into the hole I had opened and reached the space where the real heart seemed to be. However, thanks to me, the room was mostly blown apart, leaving only a faint trace of what might have been there.
“I overdid it a bit, but since we took it down, it’s all good.”
“Indeed.”
“Alright, let’s head back.”
“We finally defeated the Spirit Tortoise!”

I savored the feeling of finally being able to defeat the Spirit Tortoise alongside Father after coming to this world. I had finally fulfilled what Father couldn’t accomplish last time. Incidentally, I’ll note here that the next day, Father caused a stir by claiming he had seen a ghost again. Apparently, someone had thanked him. They disappeared right before his eyes, and not even the Soul Vacuum Shield could detect them afterward. Ren and Itsuki suggested that it might have been some vengeful spirit with a grudge against the Spirit Tortoise, but that’s another story.
“Honestly! Leaving me out is just cruel!”

Yuki-chan was pouting angrily. After defeating the Spirit Tortoise, we naturally watched and cheered for Yuki-chan in the filolial race. Of course, Yuki-chan won by a landslide. The panda seemed to have placed a half-hearted bet on Yuki-chan winning, which resulted in no profit. Father gave the winning ticket, which he had bet the same amount on Yuki-chan, to the panda. Overjoyed, the panda hugged Father tightly. Yuki-chan, overjoyed by her victory, was enthusiastically showing off to us in the audience. However, afterward, Sakura-chan, Kou, and even the other filolials found out that we had excluded Yuki-chan from the battle against the Spirit Tortoise, and they came to voice their objections to us. Currently, we are resting at the lodgings provided by the filolial-related facilities in Zeltoble. Sakura-chan, the rival, and the others whom Father considered young were already resting in their rooms. Éclair, having volunteered to assist the queen, went to help with the cleanup of the Spirit Tortoise. The cleanup was left in the hands of the queen.
“I wanted to make Yuki-chan’s dream come true, so I hardened my heart and kept it a secret.”
“I don’t like being left out!”
Yuki-chan, who is usually responsible and rarely complains, was stomping her feet in frustration. How adorable.
“Well… Motoyasu-kun kept it a secret because he was thinking about Yuki-chan, so… but yeah, it’s tough.”

Father tried to soothe Yuki-chan, looking troubled. Ren and Itsuki watched over the scene warmly. Although we had made Yuki-chan angry, in the end, it turned into a moment where everyone’s kindness could be felt.
“Oh my.”
The older sister of the sisters heard the commotion and came over. Then, she spoke gently to Yuki-chan.
“Yuki-chan, right? You understand that Motoyasu-chan was thinking about you, don’t you?”
“There will be opportunities to race as long as the world continues! But being excluded from such an important event is something I cannot forgive!”
“You’ve got a point there.”
The older sister of the sisters nodded in agreement and looked my way.
No, I wasn’t wrong!
“I had a feeling, but let’s see how Motoyasu answers.”
“Right. Naofumi-san, shouldn’t you have been the one to explain it to Yuki-san, even if it was difficult?”
“Huh? This is my responsibility now? Isn’t that a bit unreasonable? Besides, I don’t think Motoyasu-kun’s wish to let Yuki-chan race was a bad thing.”

Exactly! Father entrusted the decision to me. Choosing to prioritize Yuki-chan’s race was my decision, and I was not mistaken. It is my mission to prioritize the wishes of all filolials. I know very well how much effort Yuki-chan had put into preparing for the race. Yuki-chan was a thoroughbred filolial, fiercely competitive, and had an unyielding passion for running that she couldn’t compromise on.

How could I ever tell Yuki-chan to give up on her dream? There will be another chance? If I can’t protect Yuki-chan’s present, what meaning is there in waiting for the next opportunity? I gently touched Yuki-chan’s cheek with the same seductive gesture I used in the past on that pig, and whispered softly with kind eyes. My tone was sweet enough to almost give off a rosy breath as I murmured softly.
“Yuki-chan. Remember this well. The Spirit Tortoise is nothing more than a pebble on the path, not worth troubling your hands over.”
